remarks: Want to be near the lake? You can see Lake Erie from many windows of this home which is one block away! Perfect spot for an Air BNB or if you want to keep for yourself to enjoy the proximity to the Lake and be near the water! This large home offers as you come into the entryway foyer,  a view of the open wood spindled staircase to 2nd floor or turning and entering the 1st floor area, a good sized living room, dining room, kitchen, bathroom and bedroom. Upstairs is a roomy landing with 3 bedrooms opening off and another full bathroom. Each bedroom upstairs has a huge walk-in closest offering great storage, and large windows allowing great sunlight to come in. There is natural woodwork on both 1st and 2nd floor that is very pleasing and lends so much character! The roomy kitchen allows for great meal preparation with lots of counterspace and cabinets. Open concept right into the dining room and living room allows for comfort and bright airy rooms! The long covered porch allows for sitting and relaxing!  A brand new shed is included for outdoor storage. Updates include roof that was installed in 2024 ( 2 years old). The electrical has been updated and there is a new hot water tank. No central heat exists currently, owners use a vent free gas heater. Now is your chance to live near the lake, with a little bit of work to transform this home is what is needed to complete your 'Lake House'. The current owners have done a lot of work, some is left to do but price reflects this.  Great location if you want to be near the water! Driveway on right side of house has been unused for several years, owners park in front of house, driveway can be easily used again by just adding stone. **Motivated seller that has relocated to another State...
